displayName: Prevent co-authoring on files with macros for Word (User)
description:
This policy controls whether users will be able to co-author Word documents with macros.

Enabling this policy setting will turn off the ability to co-author Word documents with macros.

If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, the user will be able to co-author Word documents with macros.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus.
